name: Lee Mujin Service
description: "Lee Mujin Service" is a high-quality live content in which MZ generation's representative singer-songwriter Lee Mu-jin, along with other artists, provides the best music service that catches the eyes and ears of music fans around the world.

videos.title: Stray Kids' Seungmin
videos.overview: Stray Kids' Seungmin visits Lee Mujin Service where he sings Levanter, Behind the Page, My Sea and Drunken Truth.

videos.title: EXO's Suho
videos.overview: EXO's Suho visits Lee Mujin Service to be interviewed, and sings "Overdose", "Grey Suit", "Good Night" and "Instinctively".

videos.title: Stray Kids' Han
videos.overview: Stray Kids' Han visits Lee Mujin Service where he sings Case 143, Alcohol Free, Blue Whale and A Long Dream.

videos.title: Year-end Special with Kep1er's Huening Bahiyyih
April Fools' Day Special with BTS's Jimin
Stray Kids' I.N
videos.overview: Stray Kids' I.N visits Lee Mujin Service where he sings Hug Me, I Don't Love You, Perfect, and Good Night Good Dream.

videos.title: EXO's D.O.
videos.overview: EXO's D.O visits Mujin for an interview, to promote his new album and sings "Somebody", "Supermarket Flowers", "Falling Like the Stars" and "Goodbye".

videos.title: THE BOYZ’s Sangyeon, Jacob, and New
Stray Kids' Lee Know
videos.overview: Stray Kids' Lee Know visits Lee Mujin Service where he sings twilight, Only One and The One I Can't Have.

videos.title: NCT, WayV's Ten
videos.overview: Ten Lee visits Lee Mujin for an interview about his upcoming solo album and he sings "STUNNER", "Love Never Felt So Good", "Love Always Run Away" and "Better".
